headline: Gold prices drop for third consecutive time in Bangladesh
summary: The Bangladesh Jewellers Association (BAJUS) has reduced gold prices by up to 2,216 BDT per bhori.
details: The Bangladesh Jewellers Association (BAJUS) has announced a price reduction for gold for the third consecutive time in the domestic market.
According to a meeting of the BAJUS price determination and monitoring committee on Tuesday morning, the new prices are effective from 10:00 AM.
The price of 22-carat gold is now 228,556 BDT per bhori (11.664 grams), while 21-carat gold is priced at 218,292 BDT per bhori.
caption:
Gold prices in Bangladesh have fallen for the third time in a row, with reductions of up to 2,216 BDT per bhori.

The Bangladesh Jewellers Association (BAJUS) has announced a price reduction for gold for the third consecutive time in the domestic market.

According to a meeting of the BAJUS price determination and monitoring committee on Tuesday morning, the new prices are effective from 10:00 AM.

The price of 22-carat gold is now 228,556 BDT per bhori (11.664 grams), while 21-carat gold is priced at 218,292 BDT per bhori.

headline: Gold prices drop by 2,216 TK per bhori for second straight day
summary: The Bangladesh Jewellers Association (BAJUS) has adjusted rates following a decline in global market prices, marking a total drop of 6,065 TK over three phases.
details: The price of high-quality gold has decreased by a maximum of 2,216 TK per bhori in the local market, effective from 10 AM today. This adjustment by the Bangladesh Jewellers Association (BAJUS) follows a decline in both local and global gold prices.
caption:
Gold prices are falling again! High-quality gold dropped by 2,216 TK per bhori today.

The price of high-quality gold has decreased by a maximum of 2,216 TK per bhori in the local market, effective from 10 AM today. This adjustment by the Bangladesh Jewellers Association (BAJUS) follows a decline in both local and global gold prices.
